ptxt.intxrefpoff: Front Brake Caliper Disassembly and Reassembly

attention3.ptxt: Perform this inspection in the following cases.

item.ptxt: When replacing front brake pads with new ones.

servinfosub.title: Caliper Body and Carrier
servinfosub.ptxt: Check brake caliper body and carrier for deformation, crack, damage and rust. Replace front brake caliper and carrier if defective.

servinfosub.title: Piston Boot
servinfosub.ptxt: Check piston boot (1) for break and crack. Replace piston boot if defective.

servinfosub.title: Slide Pin
servinfosub.ptxt: Before installing caliper to carrier (2), check slide pins (1) for smooth thrust movement.
